description: This file defines the TransportChannelHandler class, which manages network channel events, message delegation, and timeout handling in Spark's network layer.

classes.name: TransportChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles network channel events, message processing, and timeout management for Spark's network layer.

methods.name: TransportChannelHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with network and timeout configurations.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions during channel operations, logs, and delegates to request and response handlers.

methods.name: channelActive
methods.description: Invoked when a channel becomes active; notifies request and response handlers.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Invoked when a channel becomes inactive; notifies request and response handlers.

methods.name: acceptInboundMessage
methods.description: Filters ChunkFetchRequest messages based on configuration.

methods.name: channelRead0
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, delegating to request or response handlers.

methods.name: userEventTriggered
methods.description: Handles idle state events to detect and close dead connections based on timeout.

methods.name: channelRegistered
methods.description: Increments connection count when channel is registered.

methods.name: channelUnregistered
methods.description: Decrements connection count when channel is unregistered.
